headline: Chartered Economist | Performance Measurement, KPI Scorecards & Executive Reporting | MSc Imperial College London
summary: Chartered Economist with 10+ years turning strategic objectives into measurable indicators, scorecards, and executive-ready reporting across Saudi public institutions and the private sector, including Elm itself. Designed KPI scorecards and consolidated enterprise-wide budget, financial performance, and delivery data for senior leadership at Elm; led national-scale analytical workstreams at the Ministry of Economy and Planning, coordinating data collection with 10+ government bodies and delivering decision-ready reports to ministerial leadership. Builds dashboards and performance analyses in Power BI, Tableau, R, and Stata, and identifies variances, gaps, and improvement opportunities from the evidence. MSc Economics & Strategy for Business (Imperial College London); native bilingual Arabic and English.

bullets.text: Advising private-sector clients on sector research, demand modeling, and expansion strategy aligned with Vision 2030.

Designed and delivered an end-to-end market research engagement (GCC/Jordan): consumer segmentation, willingness-to-pay modeling, and competitive analysis translated into a quantitative pricing and market-entry strategy.
Completing CFI Business Intelligence & Data Analyst (BIDA) and Financial Modeling & Valuation Analyst (FMVA) certifications while maintaining active modeling output in R and Stata.

Owned three flagship analytical workstreams (unemployment forecasting, foreign-worker remittance forecasting, and shadow-economy estimation), integrating multi-source administrative data collected in coordination with 10+ government bodies.

Communicated findings through decision-ready, executive-level reports and presentations for ministerial leadership and inter-ministerial committees, supporting cross-government knowledge-sharing across functional areas.

Lead researcher for the labor market team: designed and continuously refined national-scale methodologies on multi-year datasets, with end-to-end ownership from research design through data collection, modeling, and reporting.

Analyzed the impact of labor-market policies and regulatory developments; produced reports, technical notes, and policy briefs whose findings fed into published national strategy documents and reached the highest levels of government.
Designed and maintained executive dashboards and analytical reports communicating performance and research findings to internal and external stakeholders.
Produced economic impact analyses, predictive revenue forecasts, and competitive intelligence reports supporting multi-million SAR investment and commercial decisions.
Led sector research on the inbound tourism portfolio: demand pattern analysis, competitive benchmarking of source markets, and segmentation modeling using consumer, economic, and behavioral data.

Designed KPI scorecards and consolidated enterprise-wide budget forecasts, financial performance data, and program delivery timelines into integrated performance reporting outputs for senior leadership.

Led research and analytical workstreams across the Programs & Planning contract portfolio of national-scale digital projects, applying scenario and sensitivity analysis within multi-year planning frameworks.
Delivered organizational performance reviews, market assessments, and competitive intelligence for Saudi public and private-sector clients across government, financial services, and consumer sectors.
Designed dashboards and simulations measuring program effectiveness and supporting Vision 2030-aligned business cases.
Built the BI infrastructure for Takamol's e-learning platform; concurrently served as analytical advisor to three VPs within the Saudi Employment Department.
Developed econometric models in R and Stata supporting national labor-market research, including topical reports on telework and adjacent workforce dynamics.
Developed and presented a behavioral economics RFP submission to the Ministry of Health; the bid was successful.

cover_note:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Consultant role in Corporate Performance Management (Job Code 591284). I know Elm from the inside: as Senior Analyst, Programs & Planning (2019-2020) I designed KPI scorecards and consolidated enterprise-wide budget forecasts, financial performance data, and delivery timelines into reporting for senior leadership. Since then, as Economic Expert at the Ministry of Economy and Planning, I led national-scale analytical workstreams, coordinating data collection with 10+ government bodies and delivering decision-ready reports to ministerial leadership, and at the Saudi Tourism Authority I built executive dashboards and impact analyses behind multi-million SAR decisions. I bring evidence-based variance analysis, Power BI/Tableau/Excel reporting, and the stakeholder follow-through that performance review cycles depend on. I am not yet BSC-certified and would welcome formalizing my hands-on scorecard experience within Elm's framework. I am based in Riyadh and available for interview at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Ibrahim H. Alsalem, ChE
